verses.text: The dwelling place of all wisdom is with God, and she is with Him for eternity.
Who has measured the waves of the sea, the boundaries of the winds, and the days of eternity?
Who has explored the depths of the heavens, the expanses of the earth, and the depths of the sea, and found wisdom?
Wisdom was created before all things.
The origin of wisdom is from ancient times.
To whom has the path of wisdom been revealed?
Who has known her counsel?
Wisdom is one, and she is exceedingly to be revered;
It is He, the Lord, who created her; He alone has seen her.
And she is with Him as a gift, alongside all that is earthly.
To fear the Lord is glory;
To fear the Lord is the joy of the heart;
The man who fears the Lord shall find his end in peace;
The beginning of wisdom is to fear the Lord;
And with men, He established the foundation of the world;
To embrace wisdom is to fear the Lord;
In their houses, joy has been established;
The essence of wisdom is to fear the Lord;
His Creator does not forsake, nor does He abandon;
The root of wisdom is to fear the Lord;

sections.title: To guard oneself from sin, one must exercise self-discipline.

verses.text: For in the time of anger, affliction shall come upon you.
Until your time is fulfilled, you shall be consumed by wrath;
Until I find the time, let your matters be known to man;
In wisdom, there is a teaching of parables.
Keep the commandments if you have cherished wisdom;
Wisdom and knowledge are to fear the Lord;
Do not neglect the fear of the Lord.
While you are being shaken, serve not the Lord with a divided heart.
Do not let your mouth lead you into sin;
As your body is not to be cast down, do not exalt yourself high above.

sections.title: To be faithful unto the Lord.

verses.text: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ትገዛ ዘንድ ብትሄድ
ልብህን አቅና፥ ታገሥ፥ አታወላውልም፥
ነገር ግን ተከተለው፥
የደረሰብህን ሁሉ ተቀበል፥
ወርቅን በእሳት ይፈትኑታልና፥
ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔርን እመነው፤ እርሱም ይረዳሃል፤
እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሆይ፥ ቸርነቱን ደጅ ጥኗት፥
እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሆይ፥
እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ ሆይ፥
በዘመን የቀደሙ ሰዎችን ተመልከቱ፤ ዕወቁም፥
The Lord is merciful; let us not be consumed.
Woe unto the heart that is troubled! Woe unto the hands of the thirsty!
Woe unto the heart that is troubled and unto the heart that does not believe!
Woe unto those who have lost their patience!
Those who fear the Lord shall not forsake His word;
Those who fear the Lord shall delight in His will;
Those who fear the Lord shall prepare their hearts.
Let us fall not into the hand of man, but let us fall into the hand of the Lord.

sections.title: Children have a duty to honor their parents.

verses.text: Children, O hear me, your father,
For the Lord hath honored the father over the children.
The son who honors his father shall be delivered from sin.
And the son who honors his mother is as one who brings honor to himself.
The son who honors his father shall find joy among his children;
The son who honors his father shall have his days prolonged.
The son who heeds the Lord shall bring comfort to his mother.
Even as the servants serve their master, so shall he serve his father.
That you may attain to blessings,
For the blessing of the father shall establish the house of the son.
Do not despise your father in his old age;
My son, in the time of his need, assist your father;
If he becomes weak, and his mind falters, let them say, "It is well," for his will is good;
Concerning sin, righteousness shall work for you;
In the day of your affliction, he shall be remembered for you;
He who dishonors his father is as one who blasphemes God.
My child, let your work be revealed in your faith;
As your measure of faith is, so shall you exalt yourself.
For the work of the Lord is great;
Seek not that which would lead you astray;
But rather, consider that which you have been commanded.
Do not be led astray by unnecessary works;
Many have been led to destruction by their own folly.
He who loves destruction shall perish therein;
And an evil heart shall be consumed by trouble;
For there is no destruction for the proud.
የብልህ ሰው ልቡና ምሳሌን ይተረጕማል፤
የምትነድድ እሳትን ውኃ ያጠፋታል።
ምጽዋትን ለሚሰጥ ሰው በመጨረሻ ይታሰብለታል፤

sections.title: Concerning the treatment of the poor and the afflicted, it is fitting to act with compassion.

verses.text: My child, do not despise the one who is in need;
Do not grieve for the body that is afflicted;
Do not let your heart be troubled;
And do not be angry with your household when they serve you;
Do not turn your eye away from the one who calls you;
If your heart is saddened, do not let it be troubled;
Be one who is loved among many people;
Hear the cry of the needy with your ears;
And deliver the one who is oppressed from the hand of the oppressor;
As a father is to his son, so shall you be to the one who has died.

sections.title: Wisdom is exalted as one who acts with great discernment.

verses.text: ጥበብስ ልጆችዋን ከፍ ከፍ አደረገቻቸው፤
እርሷን የወደደ ሕይወቱን ወደደ፤
አጥንቶ የሚይዛት ሰውም ክብርን ይወርሳል፥
እርስዋንም የሚያገለግሉ ቅዱሱን ያገለግላሉ፤
እርስዋን የሚሰማትም አሕዛብን ይገዛል፤
ካመንኻት ታገኛታለህ፤
ከእርሱ ጋር ትሄድ ዘንድ ትቀድማለች፤
ከዚህ በኋላ ዳግመኛ ተቀብላ ደስ ታሰኘዋለች፤
ከእርሷ ወጥቶ ቢስት ግን ትለየዋለች።
ጊዜውን ጠብቅ፥
For in sin, one may act with deceit;
Do not let the face of man deceive you, for harm shall come upon you;
Do not scorn the words of one who speaks;
Do not forsake righteousness.
Do not be afraid to speak of your sin;
Do not bring shame upon yourself before a wicked man;
For your Creator, the Lord God, cares for you;
Let not your mouth be a source of trouble;
In your house, do not be as a fearsome lion;
Do not stretch forth your hand to strike.

sections.title: The Guide of Life for the Day

verses.text: ገንዘብህን በከንቱ አትበትን፤
የሰውነትህን ፈቃድ አትከተል።
እኔ ኀይለኛ ነኝ፤ ማንስ ይችለኛል አትበል፥
ኀጢአት ሠርቼ ፍዳ አልተቀበልሁም አትበል፥
ስለ ኀጢአትህ ንስሓ መግባትን አትፍራ።
ምሕረትም መቅሠፍትም ከእርሱ ዘንድ ይመጣልና፤
ለእግዚአብሔር መገዛትን ቸል አትበል።
በመከራህ ጊዜ አንተን ማዳን አይችልምና፤

sections.title: Concerning the selling of oneself and the being of clarity.

verses.text: ለሰው ሁሉ ምሥጢርህን አታውጣ።
አንተስ በጥበብህ ጸንተህ ኑር፤
ለመስማትም ፈጣን ሁን፤
የምትነግረው ካለህ ለባልንጀራህ ንገረው፤
መከበርህና መዋረድህ ከቃልህ የተነሣ ነው፤
ሐሜተኛ አትሁን፥ በአንደበትህም አውታታ አትሁን፤
በታላቁም በታናሹም ሰው ዘንድ
ጠላት ከምትሆን ወዳጅ ሁን፤
ከልቡናህ ባነቃኸውም ምክር ራስህን ከፍ ከፍ አታድርግ፤
ቅጠልህን ይበላብሃል፥ ፍሬህንም ታጣለህ፤
ክፉ ሰውነት ገንዘብ ያደረጋትን ሰው ታጠፋዋለች፤

sections.title: True friendship and that which is not true friendship.

verses.text: A friend is one who surpasses brotherhood;
Let many be your friends;
And a friend is one who stands by you in your troubles;
For a friend is one who is there for a little while;
An enemy may be one who opposes you and seeks to harm you;
But a friend who loves you in your adversity is indeed a true friend;
When you are in grace, he will be as you are;
But when you are in distress, he will be the one who supports you;
Far from your enemies;
A faithful friend is like a strong shelter; he who has found one has found a treasure.
ለታመነ ወዳጅ ለውጥ የለውም፤
የታመነ ወዳጅ የሕይወት መድኀኒት ነው፤
እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው ወዳጅነቱን ያጸናል፤
My child, in thy youth choose wisdom;
As one who seeks and as one who sows, let him go unto her;
She is a treasure among the wise;
When the stone of trial is cast, let it be honored in those who bear it;
Wisdom is as her name;
My child, hearken unto me, for in my counsel is strength;
Bring thy feet unto her abode;
Lower thy pride and let her carry thee;
With all thy soul, be joined unto her;
Follow her pursuit, for thou shalt find her.
In thy judgment, thou shalt find rest;
Thy feet shall be as a strong foundation unto thee;
For the gold of the world is found in her;
As a garment of honor, thou shalt be clothed;
My son, if thou art wise, thou shalt be beloved;
If thou dost listen and art beloved, thou shalt be preserved;
Stand firm in the midst of many adversaries;
Hasten to hear all the words of the book;
If a wise man sees thee, hasten and go unto him;
Consider the commandment of the Lord.
Do not commit iniquity;
Keep far from wickedness,
Lest you be ensnared by sevenfold transgression,
Do not forsake the kingdom of God;
Do not say, "I am righteous before the Lord";
Do not desire to be a judge;
And do not oppress the one who is your neighbor;
Even if it be but one, do not be entangled in wrath,
In my dwelling, the Lord has forgiven my sin abundantly;
In the time of your prayer, do not be weary,
የሚያሳዝን፥ ደስ የሚያሰኝም አለና፥
በባልንጀራህ ሐሰትን ተግባር አታድርግ፤
በምንም ሁልጊዜ ሐሰትን አትውደድ፥
በሽማግሌዎች መካከል ብዙ ቃል አትናገር፤
የእጅህንም ሥራ አታቃልል፥
ብዙ ናቸው ብለህ
ጥፋት እንደማትዘገይ ዐስብ፥
በእየነጋው ወዳጅ አትለውጥ፤
መወደዷ ከወርቅ ይወደዳልና
በእውነት በሚገዛልህ ቤተ ሰብህ ላይ፥
Love thy household as thyself;
At all times, do not forsake the care of thy livestock;
If thou shouldst have children, be mindful of them;
If thou shouldst have daughters, keep them safe;
When thou dost send forth thy son, let him be well-prepared;
If thou shouldst have a wife whom thou lovest as thyself, do not forsake her.
With all thy heart, honor thy father;
And for their sake, think as if thou wast born of them;
With all thy being, fear the Lord thy God;
With all thy strength, love thy Creator.
እግዚአብሔርን ፍራው፤
በረከትህ ፍጽምት ትሆን ዘንድ
ስጦታ በሕያው ሁሉ ፊት ጸጋ አለው፥
ከሚያለቅሱ ሰዎችም አትለይ፥
ሕመምተኛንም ሰው መጐብኘት ቸል አትበል፥
በተናገርኸው ነገር ሁሉ ፍጻሜህን ዐስባት፥
በእጃቸው እንዳትወድቅ
በብልጽግናው ድል እንዳያደርግህ ከባለጸጋ ጋር አትጣላ፥
ከተናጋሪ ሰውም ጋር አትከራከር፤
እናትና አባትህን እንዳታዋርድ፥
ከኀጢአቱ የተመለሰውን ሰው አትንቀፈው፤
በርጅናው ጊዜ ሰውን አታቅልለው፥
በሞተ ሰው ደስ አይበልህ፤
የብልሆችን ነገር አታቃልል፤
የሽማግሎችን ምክራቸውን ጠብቅ፤
በእሳታቸው እንዳትቃጠል፥
Do not let a matter disturb you,
Do not be troubled by that which is against you;
And do not be dismayed by that which is for your benefit;
Do not contend with a judge,
And do not walk in the way with a man who is contentious, lest he cause you to stumble;
Do not contend with a man of violence;
For he cannot keep the matters of heaven,
And you know not how it may come upon you;
Lest your worth be diminished.
Do not be entangled with evil instruction,
Do not let your strength be weakened,
Do not be ensnared by her allure,
Do not be captivated by her song,
Do not be drawn away by her desire,
Do not lose your inheritance,
Do not wander about the paths of the cities;
Turn your eyes away from a beautiful woman;
Do not take your stand with a harlot;
For you shall not be like a violent friend.
እንደሚጠፉ አታውቅምና
የክፉዎች ሰዎችም ተድላቸው አያስጐምጅህ፤
በሞት ከሚቀጡ መኳንንት ፈጽመህ ራቅ፤
የተቻለህን ያህል ለባልንጀራህ መልካም አድርግለት፤
ጉዳይህም ከዐዋቂዎች ጋር ይሁን፤
ድሆች ሰዎች በምሳሕ ጊዜ ይኑሩ፤
ሥራው በብልሃተኛው እጅ ይከናወናል፤
ተናጋሪ ሰው በከተማው አስፈሪ ነው፥
A wise king shall guide his people,
And he is as a leader unto his people;
A foolish king shall bring ruin upon his people;
The dominion of the earth is in the hand of the Lord God,
The blessing of man is in the hand of the Lord God.
Do not forsake your neighbor in all that befalls him,
Pride is a snare before the Lord and before man,
And the kingdom is for the sake of oppression and strife, for the sake of money,
Henceforth, it shall be a dwelling and a pillar,
He who possesses the great mercy shall save them;
And man, after he has died, shall have no greater opportunity.
The beginning of pride is to separate man from the Lord;
Pride is the beginning of sin;
The Lord shall break the thrones of the proud;
The Lord has rejected the works of the wicked.
እግዚአብሔር የአሕዛብን ሀገሮች አጠፋ፥
ፈጽሞም አጠፋቸው፥
ትዕቢት ለሰው የተፈጠረ አይደለም፥

sections.title: Glory be to that which is fitting for them and to that which is not fitting for them.

verses.text: The seed of man is a seed of honor,
The seed of man is a seed of humility,
It is more honorable than the one who is a judge,
For the one who possesses wealth and for the one who is honored, for the poor also,
The poor shall not be despised because of his poverty,
The great and the rulers, even the mighty shall be honored;
The wise household serves in purity,
When you perform your work, do not be negligent,
Rather than the one who is in distress and the one who is in need, even more than the one who does not find food,
My child, rejoice in your being according to your nature.
ለራሱ የሚነፍግ ለማን ቸር ይሆናል?
ድሃውን ስለ ጥበቡ ያመሰግኑታል፥
በተቸገረ ጊዜ የማያዝን ሰው፥
ድሃ በጥበቡ ይከብራል፤
ስለ መልከ መልካምነቱ ለሰው አታድላ፤
ንብ ከወፎች ሁሉ ታንሳለች፤
በልብስህ ጌጥ አትታበይ።
በምድር የወደቁ መኳንንት ብዙ ናቸው፤
ፈጽመው የተዋረዱ መኳንንት ብዙ ናቸው፤
ሳትመረምር አትንቀፍ፤
ሳትሰማ አትመልስ፤
ግዳጅህም ባልሆነ ነገር አትጨነቅ፤
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ሥራህን አታብዛ፤ ብታበዛ ትከብር ዘንድ አያሠለጥንህምና፤
He who is humble and works, he who is weary, is present;
While he is weary, he does not complain; he is one who is unable to do anything yet is sold;
But the Lord, when He sees with a good eye, will deliver him from his troubles.
Good and evil, life and death;
Wisdom, understanding, and knowing the law;
From the time of their birth, ignorance and darkness have dwelt with the wicked.
The grace of the Lord shall keep the righteous;
As he is honored in his speech, there is a man who is esteemed.
When hope is made to flourish,
Stand by Your covenant; in Him, be taught;
The work of the wicked shall not bring you rest,
The blessing of the Lord is the worth of the righteous,
"What is the profit of my service?
"Thus shall I speak,
In a good day, evil shall be forgotten;
The day of death is near unto the Lord;
In a day of evil, calamity shall befall;
Do not speak ill of a man before you see his end.

sections.title: Concerning the choosing of a friend.

verses.text: ተንኰለኛ ብዙ ይተነኰልብሃልና
ቆቅ በወጥመድ ይያዛል፥
ተንኰለኛ ሰው በበጎ ፋንታ ክፉ ነገርን ይከፍልሃል፤
በእሳት ትንታግ ብዛት ፍሙ ይበዛል፤
ክፉ ነገርን ይሠራብሃልና፥
ባዕድ ሰውን ከአንተ ጋር ብታሳድር ያውክሃል፤
በጎ ሥራ በሠራህ ጊዜ የበጎነትህን ዋጋ ታገኝ ዘንድ፥
ለጻድቅ በጎ አድርግ፥ ዋጋህንም ታገኛለህ፤
ኀጢአትን በሚሠራና ምጽዋትን በማይመጸውት ዘንድ፥
ኀጢአተኛ እንዳይወስድብህ ለጻድቁ ስጥ።
ለድሃ መልካም አድርግ፥ ለክፉ ግን አትስጥ፤
እግዚአብሔር ኀጢአተኞች ሰዎችን ይጠላቸዋልና፤
ለኀጢአተኛ ከምትሰጥ ለጻድቅ ስጥ፤
በመከራህም ጊዜ ጠላትህ አይሰወርህ።
ደስታህ ጠላቶችህን ያሳዝናቸዋል፤
የልቡናው ክፋት እንደ ብረት ዝገት ነውና፤
In your time of distress, He has served you with gratitude;
Let not the adversary come near you, nor let him dwell in your place;
For the serpent is a deceiver to the one who is ensnared;
And he who walks with the wicked man;
Your enemy shall stand with you for a time;
Your enemy shall twist his words against you;
Though you may be in distress, you shall find Him before all;
He shall crush with His hand; and He shall be shaken Himself;

sections.title: Concerning the keeping of a friend.

verses.text: A man who is diligent shall be held in high regard;
Do not carry the burden of the honored alone upon your own head;
Thus shall he who possesses grace be exalted, and he shall also be angered;
If there be a matter that you cherish, it shall be presented unto him;
If you possess wealth, it shall be as one with you;
If there be a servant who seeks you, he shall be a comfort unto you;
In the matter of food, he shall serve you; once, twice, and thrice shall he attend to you;
Beware of a man such as this, lest he should deceive you and lead you astray;
Let the one who has grace be mindful of you for a time;
Do not be anxious, do not be troubled;
Do not speak much with Him;
For His punishment and destruction shall not grieve you;
You shall go with your shepherd, and be aware;
He shall love you more than all beasts;
All creatures shall be one with Him, as there is no creature like Him;
With whom shall a wolf be a friend, if not with a goat?
Who shall make peace between dogs and wolves?
The beasts of the field are the offspring of lions;
A proud man shall be cast down by the one who humbles him;
When a rich man stumbles, his friends shall support him;
ባለጸጋ ቢያድጠው ብዙ ሰዎች ያነሡታል፥
ባለጸጋ ቢናገር ሁሉ ዝም ይላል፤
ኀጢአት ሳትሠራ ባለጸግነት መልካም ነው፤
ደስ ቢለው፥ ቢያዝንም
ደስ ያለው ልቡና ምልክቱ ብሩህ ገጽ ነው፥
በአፉ ያልተሰነካከለ ሰው ብፁዕ ነው፤
ሰውነቱን የማያሳዝን፥

sections.title: Concerning the proper use of wealth.

verses.text: A man who does not understand matters is not worthy of honor;
A man who consumes his own body brings shame upon another;
A man who consumes his own body finds no joy in his wealth;
There is no one who profits from a man who consumes his own body;
Even if he does good, it is only in times of distress that he is known;
The eye of a greedy man is evil;
The eye of a greedy man does not regard the portion of another;
The eye of a greedy man is like a ravenous beast;
My child, prepare your body as much as you are able;
Consider that death does not cease to exist;
ሳትሞት ለባልንጀራህ በጎ አድርግ፤
በደስታህ ጊዜ አትታጣ፤
ገንዘብህን ለባዕድ የምትተው አይደለምን?
ገንዘብህን አንሥተህ ስጥ፥
ሰው ሁሉ እንደ ልብስ ያረጃል፥
ቅጠሉ ጭፍቅ ያለ የእንጨት ቅጠል የመጀመሪያው ቅጠል እንዲረግፍ
ሥራ ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ይጠፋል፤

sections.title: Joy is found in the pursuit of wisdom.

verses.text: Yet, he who is wise shall die,
he who considers the way of wisdom in his heart,
he who follows wisdom and seeks her out,
he who visits her door,
and dwells beside her house,
he who rests near her dwelling,
and secures his children within her walls,
even he who is in the wilderness shall find refuge beneath her.
እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው እንዲህ ያደርጋል፤
እንደ እናቱ ትንከባከበዋለች፤
የጥበብን እህል ትመግበዋለች፤
በእርስዋ ይመረኰዛል፥ አይፍገመገምም፤
ከባልንጀራው ይልቅ ከፍ ከፍ ታደርገዋለች፥
ደስታን ትሰጠዋለች፥
አላዋቂዎች ግን አያገኙአትም፤
ከትዕቢተኞች ሰዎችም የራቀች ናት፤
የኀጢአተኛ ሰው የቃሉ ነገር ያማረ አይደለም፥
ምሳሌን በጥበብ ይናገሯታል፤
"Do not say, 'I have been provoked by the Lord';
"Do not say, 'He has led me astray';
For the Lord will cast away all whom He has blessed;
He has created man in purity from the beginning;
To keep His commandment is to guard oneself;
By choosing your hand, you shall increase;
For life and death are before man;
The wisdom of the Lord is great;
His eyes behold those who fear Him;
And He does not allow sin to be committed against Him.
Do not covet many children who have no benefit;
For they have no fear of the Lord God within them;
And do not trust in their lives;
For in one wise nation, you shall be preserved;
My eyes have seen many things such as this.
In the fire of the wicked, she shall be consumed;
And the mighty who have trusted in their strength, the former warriors also
have turned to Lot, and they have brought upon themselves their own destruction;
The wicked do not show mercy to the peoples;
These also have gathered, and their hearts have become hardened.
If a man were to guard his heart,
His anger is measured by the abundance of his kindness.
A sinful man shall not be answered from the depths.
All the righteous shall bring forth forgiveness.
"I shall be answered by the Lord;
There is none among many nations who knows me."
"What is the measure of my body in all the world?" do not say.
Behold, the heavens, above the heavens of the heavens,
And the mountains, and the foundations of the earth,
Let not this enter the heart.
ከሥራውም አብዛኛው ስውር ነው፥
እውነት ሥራ መሥራትን ማን ያስተምራል?
አእምሮ የሌለው ሰው እንዲህ ያስባል፤

sections.title: The wisdom of the Lord is in the creation of all things.

verses.text: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስማኝ፥ ጥበብንም ተማር፥
በሚዛን መዝነህ ጥበብህን ግለጣት፤
የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ከጥንት ጀምሮ በሥልጣኑ ተፈጠረ።
ዓለም ለዘለዓለም ጸንቶ ይኖር ዘንድ ሥራውን ሁሉ አዘጋጀ፥
አንዱ ከሌላው ጋር አይጨናነቅም፤
ከዚህ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ምድርን ተመለከተ፤
በደማዊት ነፍስ ሕያው የሆነ ፍጥረት ሁሉ በምድር መላ፤
እግዚአብሔር ሰውን ከምድር ፈጠረው፥
ዓመታትንና ቀናትን በቍጥር ሰጣቸው፤
ለእየራሳቸው ኀይልን አሳደረባቸው፤
ፍጥረቱ ሁሉ እንዲፈሩአቸው አደረገ።
አውሬዎችንና ወፎችንም እንዲገዟቸው አደረገ።
ቃልንና አንደበትን፥ ዐይንና ጆሮን፥
ጥበብን ማወቅንም አጠገባቸው፤
የሥራውን ገናናነትና መፈራቱንም ያሳያቸው ዘንድ፥
ቅዱስ ስሙን ያመሰግኑት ዘንድ።
የሥራውንም ገናናነት ይናገሩ ዘንድ፥
He granted them wisdom;
And they were filled with the knowledge of the everlasting.
Their eyes beheld the glory of His majesty.
And their ears heard the word of His sovereignty,
They were kept from all sin;
Their path was always before Him,
He declared to all nations His kingship.
But Israel became the portion of the Lord.
And all their works are before Him as the sun;
Their iniquities were not hidden from Him.
የሰው ምጽዋቱ ከእርሱ ጋራ እንደ ማኅተም ነው።
የሰው ዋጋው እንደ ዐይን ብሌን ትጠበቅለታለች።
ኋላ ተመልሶ ዋጋቸውን ይሰጣቸዋል፤
ነገር ግን ንስሓ የሚገቡበትን መንገድ ሰጣቸው፤
ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለስ፥
ከበደልህም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለስ፤
በሕይወት ሳሉ እንደሚገዙለት ሰዎች፥
የሞተ ሰውን ግን ንስሓ እንደ ኢምንት አለፈው፤
የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነቱ ታላቅ ነውና፤
ሰው ሟች ስለ ሆነ፥
ከፀሐይ የሚበራ ምን አለ? እርሱም እንኳ ያልፋል።
እርሱ የሰማይን ምጥቀት ኀይል ያውቃል፥
He who is the living God for eternity created all things in unity.
The true God is but one.
He does not regard anyone as unworthy, for He knows His work.
Who can comprehend His greatness?
There is no beginning; there is no end.
When He created man, He made him a living being.
What is man? What is his significance?
What is goodness? What is wickedness?
Like a single drop of water in the sea, so is one among the many.
Therefore, the Lord shall take heed of them.
ፍጻሜያቸው ክፉ እንደ ሆነ አይቶ ዐወቃቸው፤
ሰው ባልንጀራውን ብቻ ይቅር ይላል፥
ይቈጣል፥ ይገርፋል፥ ይቅር ይላል፥
My child, amidst thy joy, let not sorrow enter in;
Is there not a sound that brings forth lamentation?
Behold, is there not a good word that is better than giving?
The heart shall be given joy, yet it shall not be without sorrow.
Speak not hastily, understand; do not ponder without thought.
Without being led astray, examine thyself;
Do not be weary, but uplift thyself;
Swiftly bring forth thy vision;
Before thou art troubled, prepare thy vision;
In the time of thy anger, remember the day of death.
In the days of your calamity, remember the days of your prosperity.
For life shall change from morning until evening.
A wise man, however, shall be cautious in all things.
The discerning man shall obtain wisdom in all matters.
But the knowledgeable shall be troubled within their own hearts.
Do not depart, neither follow the desires of sin.
For what you love for your own body, if it is given to you,
In abundance, do not let joy escape you.
As you do not despair while you are poor, do not be disheartened even if you have nothing in your possession.
A servant shall not be despised,
Wine and a woman shall cause the wise to err,
And the end thereof is great destruction.
Swift is the heart that believeth,
A man who brings joy to his heart shall be blessed.
Much speaking doth lead to sin,
Do not disregard the word thou hast heard, neither let it be forgotten,
That which thou speakest in the presence of friend and foe should not be unheeded,
If it be heard, it shall not be forgotten by thee,
Do not disregard the word thou hast heard.
A man who is not wise shall be confounded until he brings forth that which he has heard,
And a man who is slain shall be as one who is pierced through by his own sword,
And concerning thy friend, it shall be as if he hath not done,
And concerning thy friend, it shall be as if he hath not spoken,
And concerning thy friend, being ensnared by a treacherous matter shall come upon him, therefore let him be reproached;
Who is he that cannot be deceived in a single matter?
In the midst of anger, let thy friend be reproached,
Wisdom is to fear the Lord in all things, for He is the Almighty.
ክፉን የሚያስተምር ጥበብ የለም፥
ከሁሉ የምትረክስ ክፋት አለች፥
ነገር ግን ከሚራቀቅ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሕግ ከሚክድ ይልቅ፥
እየበደለ የሚራቀቅና የሚጠነቀቅ አለ፥
እያመሰገነ ለክፉ ነገር የሚያደላ ሰው አለ፥
በልቡናው ሌላ ነገር እያለ ፊት አይቶ የሚያዳላ አለ፥
ኀይሉ ቢደክም፥ በአንተም ላይ ክፉ ማድረግ ቢሳነው፥
ሰው በመልኩ ይታወቃልና፥ ጠቢብም በገጹ ይታወቃል።
ካለባበሱና ካካሄዱ፥ ከአሳሣቁም የተነሣ፥
There exists a man who is not for good but brings forth harm;
Yet it is better to be silent than to provoke strife.
He who believes in the error shall be delivered from destruction.
A man who loves to judge shall be judged himself;
There is a man who, knowing, remains silent;
A man who does not recognize the one who returns shall also be silent;
The wise man remains silent until he finds his time;
The one who exceeds in matters shall be cast out;
There is a man who causes trouble;
There is a man who gives you what does not benefit you.
እየተቸገረ ራሱን የሚያኰራ አለ፤
በጥቂት ብዙ የሚገዛ አለ፤
ብልህ ሰው በቃሉ ራሱን ያስወድዳል፤
አላዋቂ ሰው ጥቅምና ተወዳጅነት የሌለውን ገንዘብ ይሰጥሃል፤
ጥቂት ቢሰጥህ ብዙ እንደ ሰጠህ ይላገድብሃል፤
አላዋቂ ሰው ግን “ወዳጅ አልፈልግም ምን ይጠቅመኛል?
ሁሉም ሁልጊዜ ያሙኛል፤

sections.title: A discourse that is not fitting.

verses.text: በአንደበትህ አድጦህ ከምትወድቅ፥
እንዳገኘ የሚናገር ሰው ራሱን ያስነውራል፤
በጊዜው አይናገረውምና፥
በተቸገረ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ወደ መፍራት የሚመለስ ሰው አለ፤
በማፈርም ሰውነቱን የሚያጠፋ አለ፤
በማፈር ላይሰጠው ለወዳጁ ተስፋ የሚሰጠው አለ።
የሐሰተኛ ሰው ውርደቱ ክፉ ነው፤
ከሐሰተኛ ሌባ ይሻላል፤
ሐሰተኛ ሰው ፈጽሞ ይዋረዳል፥ ያፍራልም።
በቃሉ ብልህ የሆነ ሰው ነገሩ ይሰማል፤
ምድርን የሚያርሳት የእህሉን ክምር ያበዛል፤
እጅ መንሻና መማለጃ የጠቢባንን ዐይን ያሳውራል፤
የተሰወረ ጥበብ እንደ ተቀበረ ወርቅ ነው፤
ጥበቡን ከሚሰውር ብልህ ሰው፤
My son, if there be a transgression that thou hast committed,
as a lion flees from the evil beast, so also let sin flee from thee,
for as a sword that is double-edged, so is every sin;
to be hasty and to be proud, these have led to the downfall of many;
in the time of need, the mouth is opened even unto the depths of the grave;
he who despises counsel shall follow the path of sinners;
a man who is able to speak shall be known from afar;
he who labors for his house with borrowed money,
the unity of sinners is as a net of deceit;
the way of sinners is as a crooked path.
He who guards his heart shall keep the law of the Lord.
A man who is unlearned shall not be wise;
The thoughts of a wise man are as abundant as the waters of the spring;
A man without understanding is like a house built upon sand;
A prudent man, when he hears a matter of wisdom, shall take heed;
The words of an unlearned man are like a stone cast upon a distant path, as if to be honored by the dust;
The words of a wise man shall be heard in the assembly;
Wisdom among the unlearned is as a house of treasures;
The instruction of the unlearned is as a foot that is bound;
An unlearned man shall raise his voice in the time of trouble.
ጥበብ በአስተዋይ ሰው ዘንድ እንደ ወርቅ ጌጥ ናት፥
ያላዋቂ ሰው እግር ፈጥና ወደ ቤት ትገባለች፤
አላዋቂ ሰው በደጃፍ ሆኖ የሰው ቤትን ይመለከታል፤
ለሰው በበር ተጠግቶ ማድመጥ አላዋቂነት ነው፤
የለፍላፊ ከንፈር የማይመለከተውን ይናገራል፤
ያላዋቆች ልባቸው ባፋቸው ነው፤
ኀጢአተኛ ሰው ሰይጣንን ቢረግመው ራሱን መርገሙ ነው።
ሐሜተኛ ሰው ሰውነቱን ያረክሳል፤
A slothful man is as a stone in the place where he is set;
A slothful man is as a door that turneth upon its hinges;
A son who is not corrected is a shame to his father;
A wise woman inheriteth glory from her husband;
She also bringeth shame upon her mother; she also bringeth shame upon her husband; she is indeed a disgrace.
ባገኘበት ቦታ ነገሩን የሚናገር ሰው፥
ሰነፍ ሰውን የሚያስተምር ሰው፥ የተሰበረ ገልን እንደሚጠግን ሰው ነው፤
ለሰነፍ ሰው የሚነግር በጽኑዕ እንቅልፍ ለተያዘ ሰው እንደሚነግር ነው፤
ብርሃኑ አልፏልና ለሞተ ሰው አልቅስለት፤
ከሞተ በኋላ አይመለስምና፥
ሰዎች ስለ ሞተ ሰው ሰባት ቀን ያለቅሱለታል፤
ከሰነፍ ሰው ጋራ ነገርን አታብዛ፤
ከእርሱ ራቅ፤ ሰውነትህም ታርፋለች፤ ይቀልሃልም፤
ከአረር የሚከብድ ምን አለ?
ከሰነፍ ሰው ጋራ ከመኖር፥
The tower stands firm, as a house built upon a rock shall not be moved in the time of shaking upon the earth,
And the gate shall not fall for eternity;
As the wind blows before the face of the storm, so shall the breath not cease in the time of its blowing,

sections.title: And to preserve friendship, let it be cherished.

verses.text: The man who guards his eye shall weep.
The man who has fallen upon the stone of the birds shall be crushed by it.
If you draw a sword against your friend,
yet if you should repent,
even if you are poor, in the time of his joy you shall rejoice with him.
The fire and the smoke shall precede it;
I shall not forsake my friend.
Yet if, because of him, you should be in distress,
who shall be my protector in my solitude?

sections.title: A prayer for deliverance from sin.

verses.text: O Lord, my Father, Creator of my life,
Who shall guard my heart from evil?
That sin may not overwhelm me, nor may my iniquities overtake me,
My Lord, my Father, O Creator of my life,
Keep me far from temptation.
Let not calamity befall me; let not affliction come upon me;

sections.title: Concerning the eating of the flesh.

verses.text: Children, hearken unto the counsel of your father;
The sinner is ensnared by his own transgressions;
My son, do not forsake the instruction of your mouth;
Always, as he is entangled, the servant who is bound cannot escape;
The man who is consumed by lust is greatly burdened by his sins;
There is a word that brings forth death;
For within him are many transgressions;
Remember your father and your mother;
There is no man who is not prone to folly.
There are two that bring forth sin;
The woman who is a seducer will ensnare all men;
The man who forsakes his wife,
Yet he fears the eyes of man, lest he be seen;
All is known before his creation, for it is revealed to Him;
In the midst of the city, she shall be cast out;
A woman who walks in deceit is likewise;
She has committed a single transgression against the Lord;
Such a woman shall be brought low;
Her offspring shall perish.
ስም አጠራሯም የተረገመ ይሆናል፤
ያያት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ከመፍራት የሚበልጥ፥
Wisdom praises herself;
In the assembly of the Most High, she speaks;
Thus she said: I came forth from the mouth of the Most High;
I dwelt in the heavens;
And I alone was established in the heights of heaven;
And upon the waves of the sea, I walked in every place;
After all these things, I sought rest;
After this, I commanded all that was created;
Before the world was made, I was brought forth;
And in the holy dwelling, I was ministered before Him;
እንዲሁም በተወደደችው ከተማ ዐረፍሁ፤
በእግዚአብሔር ርስት ዕድል ፋንታ፥
በሊባኖስ እንዳለ ዝግባ ከፍ ከፍ አልሁ፤
በውኃ ዳር እንዳለ ዘንባባም ረዘምሁ፤
መዓዛዬም እንደ ቀናንሞስና እንደ ደርሶኒ ሽቱ የተወደደ ሆነ፤
ቅርንጫፎች እንደ ቡጥም ረዘሙ፤
እኔስ እንደ ተወደደ የወይን ሐረግ መወደድን አስገኘሁ።
አበባዬም የክብርና የባለጸግነት ፍሬ ነው።
የምትወዱኝ ሰዎች ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ኑ፤
ስም አጠራሬ ከማር፥
Those who seek to harm me shall not prevail against me;
Those who listen to me shall not be forsaken;
All these matters are the sacred writings of the Most High Law;
He who trusts in the Lord shall not be shaken;
Wisdom is like the flowing of a river;
Counsel is like the flowing of a fountain;
Wisdom is like the light;
I do not know the beginning;
Its secret is greater than the waters of the sea;
I have become like water that flows from a river;
እንዲህም አልሁ፥ “የተክል ቦታዬን ላጠጣት፤ የጎመን ቦታዬን ላጠጣት፤”
ዳግመኛም ጥበብን እንደ ጥዋት አበራታለሁ፤
ትምህርትን እንደ ትንቢት አፈስሳታለሁ፤
እነሆ፥ የደከምሁ ለሚፈልጉኝ ሰዎች ሁሉ ነው እንጂ፥
In these three matters, I shall be wise;
Three types of men have pursued my body;
From your childhood, you have not been restrained;
A judgment of seven shall be rendered;
And for the wise, wisdom shall be their due;
The abundance of learning is the companion of the wise;
In my heart, they are nine who have troubled me;
The heart that possesses a woman is pure;
The man who gains knowledge and wisdom,
How great is the man who has acquired wisdom!
The fear of the Lord is greater than all.
There is none that resembles one who is kept by her.
Rather than all affliction, the affliction of the heart shall prevail;
In all things, though you may fall, do not fall into the hand of your enemy;
There is no head that is more exalted than the head of a serpent;

sections.title: The deeds of a wicked woman.

verses.text: Do not dwell with a wicked woman,
Her wickedness shall change you;
And among her companions, she shall cause you to stumble;
All wickedness is as a woman's wickedness;
As the spider weaves her web, so do the wicked ensnare their prey;
The beauty of a woman is not to be trusted, nor her wealth to be relied upon.
If a woman be joined to her husband,
She is a snare to the heart, a darkness to the face, and a sorrow to the soul;
In the beginning, sin was found with a woman;
Do not let her be a source of water for you.
If it is not according to your custom, let it be so;

sections.title: The act of a virtuous woman.

verses.text: A good wife is a blessing to her husband;
A virtuous woman brings joy to her husband;
The life of a good wife is pleasant and admirable;
May the heart of the wealthy and the poor alike be at peace;
In these three things, my heart rejoiced greatly;
A woman who brings comfort is a treasure of the heart; she is also the sorrow of the flesh;
A wicked woman is like a wild beast, as it is said, she is like a bull's horn;
A deceitful woman is a great destruction.
The mourning of a woman is known by her eyes;
Let her not destroy herself;
Keep watch over the eyes of the unfaithful;
She, who is thirsty, drinks as if she were consuming all the water that is brought to her;
And she is like one who draws out the essence from what is given to her.

sections.title: The blessing of a virtuous woman.

verses.text: The beauty of a woman brings joy to her husband.
Wisdom does not depart from her bones.
A virtuous woman is a gift from God.
A wise woman has no need for change.
A woman who fears the Lord is blessed beyond measure.
A patient woman has no need for change.
As the sun shines in the heavens of the Lord,
So does the light of the consecrated shine upon her dwelling.
Like gold ornaments that rest upon silver,
My heart is troubled by these three things.
The fourth, however, has brought me to distress.
And these, the warrior and the oppressed, when they are troubled,
wise men shall be silent;
they are the ones who turn righteousness into sin.
Thus has the Lord destroyed that which is in battle.
The sinner shall be crushed under the weight of his iniquity;
Many are they who commit sin with impunity;
As a thorn is planted among the stones,
If one hastens in fear of the Lord and does not wait for Him,
In the day of calamity, he shall be delivered;
The fire shall consume the wood of the wicked;
The man who keeps the vine shall see its fruit;
Do not forsake a man without aiding him;
If you pursue righteousness, you shall be found;
A bird shall dwell with its kind;
The lion shall be preserved from its prey;
The righteous man shall always teach wisdom;
In the time of calamity, guard your heart;
The matter of calamity shall befall them;
A man who speaks many words will restrain the light;
The prideful shall have their blood poured out;

sections.title: The secret of the neighbor shall not be revealed, for it is not fitting.

verses.text: He who reveals the secret of his neighbor shall cause his own destruction;
Keep thy friend; trust in him, and be united with him;
As a man drives away his enemy,
So shall a bird escape from thy hand;
As a hare escapes from the snare;
If it be a trap, it was in their midst; for the one who was cast out was among them.
There is none who can bear the burden;
Yet for thine eyes, it shall be a burden unto thee;
For there are many who seek to harm me;
The stone that is rolled upward shall fall upon the one who rolls it;
For the one who is ensnared by his own folly, he shall fall within himself;
When a man commits sin, it shall return upon him;
The pride of the arrogant and their mockery;
The righteous man shall rejoice at the downfall of the wicked, for they shall be taken in their own snare;
For wrath and anger are their companions.
The Lord shall deliver into the hands of him who seeks to harm Him;
Let them forgive the wrongs you have done to your neighbor;
When you are a man, do not change the one who is like you;
Do not say, "Forgive the one who is like you";
If the flesh is for the one who is weak;
Consider your end, and guard your thoughts;
Consider the law, and do not change your neighbor;
To forgive your sins, turn away from strife;
A sinful man also harms his neighbor;
Just as the wood is, so shall the fire grow;
He who provokes anger is like one who kindles a fire;
If you call upon her, she shall respond;
The one who is a slanderer and has two faces shall be cast out;
A deceitful tongue has led many people astray;
The deceiver has driven away women from their homes, causing them to flee;
But the one who is not trusted by her shall not be forsaken for eternity;
The curse of the wicked shall be upon him;
There are many who have fallen in battle;
She who has been forsaken and has not been rescued from her destruction;
Her covering is as a covering of iron;
Her death is indeed a wicked death;
But do not let them reach the righteous;
Those who have offended the Lord shall fall by her;
When you take your possessions with deceit,
And when you weigh your matters with false scales,
Let not the oppressor be found in your dwelling, lest you be ensnared.

sections.title: Concerning the act of gathering and the gathering itself.

verses.text: ምጽዋትን የሚመጸውት ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር ያበድራል፤
በደስታው ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ደስ ይልህ ዘንድ፥
ቃልህን ጠብቅ፤ ከእርሱም ጋራ ተማመን፤
የብድርን ገንዘብ በምድር ላይ ወድቆ ያገኙት የሚመስላቸው ብዙዎች ናቸው፤
እስኪበደርህ ድረስ ራስህን ይስምሃል፤ ቃሉንም ያለሰልሳል፤
እኩሌታውን ቢከፍልህ በጭንቅ ነው፤
ገንዘባቸውን እንዳያጡና እንዳይጣሉ በመፍራትና ጠብን ባለመውደድ ገንዘባቸውን የማያበድሩ ሰዎች ብዙ ናቸው።
ድሃዉን ግን ታገሠው፤
ችግረኛ ነውና በሕግ እንደ ታዘዘው ድኃዉን በምጽዋት ተቀበለው፤
ባልንጀራህንና ወዳጅህን ከምታጣ፥
ስለ ልዑል ትእዛዝ በወርቅህ አስተዋፅኦ አድርግ፤
ምጽዋትን በቤቶችህ አድልባት፤ እርስዋም ትሻላለች፤
She shall prevail over the warrior and the shield;
Indeed, a man shall befriend his neighbor;
For concerning you, she has delivered her body as a sacrifice;
To preserve life, it is indeed a good thing to strive;
But the sinful man shall be ensnared by the one he has spared;
Striving has grieved many a diligent man;
Yet the sinful man shall perish through striving;
In your ability, assist your neighbor;
The beginning of your life is bread and water, and clothing;
If you rejoice in another's wealth, you shall be fulfilled in your own house;
ለታናሹም ለታላቁም ሥራህንና ቃልህን አሳምር።
ካንዱ ቤት ወደ ሌላው ቤት የሚዞር ሰው ኑሮው ክፉ ነው፤
ያም ባይሆን ታበላለህ፤ ታጠጣለህም፤
በተዘጋጀህ ጊዜ ግን እንዲህ ይሉሃል፥ “እንግዳችን ገብተህ ማዕድን ሥራ፤ ያለህንም አብላን።”
ብትቸገር ግን፥ “እንግዳችን ውጣ፤
ይህ ነገር በብልህ ሰው ዘንድ ጭንቅ ነው፤
He who loves his son shall rejoice in him at his coming;
He who chastises his son shall find joy in him;
He who instructs his son shall deliver him from his enemies;
After him, a son like him shall arise;
While he is alive, he shall find joy in his son;
After him, he who delivers his enemies shall be blessed;
He who neglects his children shall be filled with sorrow;
An unbroken horse shall become wild;
If you have raised your son, he shall return to you in strength;
Do not provoke him to sorrow, lest you be grieved.
In the time of thy youth, do not forsake thy son.
In a time of danger, let it not be that thou art ensnared.
In his destruction, let it not be that thou art consumed.
When the body is afflicted, let it be with grace.
May your body be in health;
Health shall not be chosen over grace;
Better is life with affliction than death with ease.
A meal prepared with care is offered;
What benefit is there in feasting for idols?
As the beautiful maiden is adorned, let us be mindful of the time;
Do not let your soul be troubled;
The joy of the heart is life unto man;
Keep your heart steadfast, that you may be free from sorrow.
Anger and wrath shall bring forth the days of life;
As one who is pursued, even as a man is overtaken;
Let them be wise, for it is for those who love them, all indeed;
Hearken unto me, O ye rulers of the people;
Thy son and thy wife, thy brother and thy friend, while thou art in life, do not neglect them for thy riches;
While thou art in life,
thou shalt grasp the hand of thy children as they are trained;
In all thy labor, be thou prudent;
All the days of thy life shall be in the time of the old;
Bind thy horse, load it, and in the wilderness, let it be thy refuge;
And let thy servants be made to serve; and thou shalt find rest.
The burden of the day shall weigh down the back.
Let thy servant be made to work.
For the abundance of service shall teach much wickedness.
As much as one is able, let him render his work.
If thou shouldst have a servant, let him be as thyself.
Yet if thou doest evil, it shall be unto thee as a burden; it shall weigh heavily upon thee.
A deceitful man, indeed, shall place his hope in vanity;
A man who believes in a dream is like one who is caught in a snare;
A dream goes from here to there;
What can come forth from the unclean?
Dreams, vanity, and all falsehoods are but empty;
Forgive me, for it is not that which is sent from the Lord God that has not come to pass;
For many have been led astray by dreams;
Without deceit, the truth shall be revealed;
A learned man knows much counsel;
But a man who is untrained knows nothing at all.
A man who has endured much affliction shall gain much wisdom.
In the time when I received affliction, I beheld many things;
Until death comes, I shall always receive affliction;
The soul that fears the Lord shall be preserved.
All who have placed their hope in Him shall be preserved.
There is none who causes fear to the man who fears the Lord;
The man who fears the Lord is a soul of righteousness.
For He shall deliver him, for he is a faithful friend.
The eyes of the Lord are upon His friends; His strength is for the faithful; His protection is strong; He has prepared a refuge for you;
He shall encircle your body; He shall also enlighten your eyes;
የበደል መባእ መሥዋዕት ርኩስ ነው፤
የኀጢአተኞችም መባእ ተቀባይነት የለውም።
በመባህ ብዛት ኀጢአትህ የሚሰረይልህ አይደለም።
በዐመፃ ገንዘብ መባእን የሚያገባ ሰው፤
የድሃ ሕይወቱ ምጽዋት መለመን ነው፤
ባልን ከሚስቱ የሚያፋታ ሰው፥
የምንደኛውን ደመወዝ የቀማ ሰው፥
አንዱ ሲሠራ አንዱ ቢያፈርስ፥
አንዱ ሲመርቅ ሌላው ቢረግም፥
ሬሳ ከዳሰሰ በኋላ እጁን ቢታጠብ፥
Likewise, concerning sin, the one who fasts shall be greatly rewarded, for he has departed from it.
He who keeps the law shall be blessed.
And he who heeds the command shall offer sacrifices for his prosperity.
A man who brings in grain shall receive his reward.
He who brings forth offerings shall present the sacrifices of thanksgiving.
The will of the Lord is that you do not do evil.
And before the Lord, do not come empty-handed.
Do all this for the sake of the command.
The sacrifices of a righteous man are without blemish;
The sacrifices of a righteous man are holy.
With joy, let us give thanks to the Lord.
Give unto him all that you have, rejoicing in your presence;
According to the measure of His glory, let your offering be acceptable unto the Lord;
For the Lord shall return your worth unto you;
He shall not reject you, nor shall He refuse your supplication.
For the Lord is a judge of truth;
He does not regard the plight of the poor;
The son of the dead shall not say, "Do not trouble me";
Even if tears fall upon her face,
So shall tears descend upon the one who is afflicted.
The one who truly serves shall be accepted.
The prayer of the humble ascends like a cloud,
He shall judge the righteous; He shall have mercy upon them;
He shall have mercy upon the multitudes; He shall destroy all the wicked;
To every man, according to his work, shall He render unto him.
Concerning all men, according to their deeds,
In the time of trouble, mercy shall be found.

sections.title: A prayer offered concerning the affliction of Israel.

verses.text: O Lord, Creator of all power, have mercy upon us; return unto us.
Cause Thy fear to be upon all nations.
Stretch forth Thy hand upon the peculiar peoples.
For they behold us as we are gathered unto Thee.
O Lord, there is no other creator besides Thee.
Show forth Thy wonders.
In Thy hand is power, and on Thy right hand is glory.
Bring upon them destruction.
And cause the oppressor to perish.
Let Thy marvelous works be declared, that they may consider the greatness of Thy might.
They shall be consumed with wrath and fire;
Let them break the heads of the enemies who say, "There is no other man but us."
Gather together all the sons of Jacob.
A good heart does not covet the bread of deceit;
The thoughts that are troubled by anxiety are cast down by sleep;
The one who possesses wealth is held captive by it;
The poor suffer from the lack of money;
A man who loves money will not be satisfied;
There are many who have fallen because of money;
Money is like a tree of slumber for those who desire it;
Pure is he who is free from sin;
Who is he that does good for his kin?
In Him is found that which is unbroken, and He does not forsake.
Her blessing shall endure; and her cry shall be heard in the land of the nations.
If thou shouldst dwell in a great palace,
Consider that the eye of man is evil;
Do not be anxious concerning all that is before thee;
Know the counsel of thy companion;
Speak as a wise man who hath been given counsel;
As a wise man, go forth before all, do not be anxious;
Even among many, if thou shouldst dwell,
In thy sleep, let not thy belly be burdened;
The one who is filled is a man whose sleep is health;
When thou eatest, if they say, "Arise," do so before them.
My son, do not forsake me; do not disregard my plea.
A man shall be judged according to his labor.
Wine hath caused many to stumble.
Strong drink is a source of strife.
The life of man is to drink wine.
It is joy to the heart; it is mirth to the body.
And wine shall remove the sorrow from the heart.
A foolish man, when he drinketh wine, shall increase his quarrels; he shall be led astray and shall become foolish.
And when wine is poured out, do not provoke your neighbor.
If you are called, do not exalt yourself;
Complete your work and rest;
O hearer, speak; for it is fitting for you,
Do not speak your word to every man who seeks to inquire of you;
Like gold in a precious setting, joy is as a sweet fragrance;
Like a golden ornament upon a beautiful garment;
O Golmasa! Speak if you have been permitted;
Once you have spoken, then complete your matter;
Do not take your stand among the great;
As lightning runs before the thunder, so is the honor of a man who is respected before him.
And when you enter your house, do all things in their time.
Do that which is fitting and that which is beloved.
Along with all these, give thanks to your Creator.
እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው ለሕጉ ይገዛል፤
ሕጉንም የሚፈልገው ከእርሱ ይጠግባል፤
እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩት ሰዎች ፍርድን ያገኛሉ፤
ኀጢአተኛ ሰው ግን የሚመክሩትን አይሰማም፤
ብልህ ሰው ያለ ምክር የሚሠራው ሥራ የለም፤
ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ ግን ያለ ምክር የምትሠራው ሥራ አይኑር፤
በጥፋት ድንጋይ እንዳትሰነካከል፥
ጠላትህን በምድረ በዳ አትመነው።
በፈቃድህ የማይሄድ ልጅህን ስንኳ አትመነው።
በሠራኸው ሥራ ሁሉ ሰውነትህን ደስ አሰኛት፥
ሕጉን የሚጠብቅ ሰው የመጽሓፉን ትእዛዝ ይሰማል፤
ይፈትኑት ዘንድ ነው እንጂ፥
ብልህ ሰው መጽሐፍ መስማትን ይወድዳል፤
ብልህ ሰው አምኖ በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ይገዛል፤
የምትናገረውን ነገርህን አዘጋጅተህ አድምጥ፤
የሰነፍ ሰው ልቡና እንደ ሰረገላ መንኰራኵር ነው፤
ጮሌ ፈረስ እንደ በጎ ወዳጅ ነው።
የዓመቱ ቀን ሁሉ በፀሐይ ብርሃን ጸንቶ ሲኖር፥
ቀኑ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ይለያል፤
ከቀኑም የቀደሰውና ያከበረው አለ።
እኛ ሁላችን የአዳም ልጆች ከመሬት ተገኘን፤
And the Lord bestowed upon them abundant wisdom;
Among them are those whom He has blessed and exalted greatly;
We all are as clay in the hand of the potter before Him;
The adversary of sin is good;
Behold the lofty creations alongside all these;
But I, having risen after all, have contemplated this matter;
O Lord, forgive Thy people who are called by Thy name;
Thy holy city,
and fill Zion with the blessing of Thy word;
Beforehand, grant them Thy law for their creation;
Let those who trust in Thy prophets give unto Thee their worth for the hope they have placed in Thee.
And let the blessing of Aaron be bestowed upon Thy people.
Every grain shall be consumed; and it shall descend unto the belly.
The taste of every grain shall be discerned,
A wicked heart bringeth forth sorrow.
And every man shall take unto himself a wife.
The beauty of a woman doth shine forth upon her face.
Though she be fair, if her speech be sweet,
Her help is a comfort, and she is a refuge.
A house without a door shall see its wealth diminish.
Who is he that roams from city to city, a thief who wanders about?
And every man who is a friend shall say, "I am also his friend;"
But in his heart, until the day he dies, sorrow shall dwell;
O evil desire! From whence hast thou come upon me?
There is a friend who draws near in thy time of joy;
There is a friend who weeps for thee in thy time of sickness;
In the time of thy distress, do not forsake thy friend;
Every wise man shall give counsel;
Keep thy heart with all diligence from the one who counsels thee;
That which may cause thy wealth to perish shall be brought upon thee;
Do not associate with the one who would betray thee.
Do not speak concerning that which causes a woman to be troubled;
As faith exists, so does the fear of the Lord;
She is more trustworthy than all;
The heart of man is more than seven watchmen;
With all this, He will guide your way in truth;
The beginning of all wisdom is the word;
The sign of a man's heart is seen in the four directions.
These are sorrow and joy, death and life.
There is a man who teaches all, and he knows much;
In matters that cause one to stumble, there is indeed a man who leads himself astray.
The Lord shall not grant favor,
For he is self-sufficient,
A wise man shall counsel his kin;
A wise man shall be blessed abundantly;
The days of man are numbered;
A prudent man shall find his worth among his kin;
My son, while you are in life, take care of your body,
For not all that pertains to the body is fitting;
Do not be gluttonous for food;
For much eating shall lead to sorrow.
There are many who have been slain.

sections.title: The Lord is my Savior and Redeemer.

verses.text: Honor the Healer,
For salvation is found with the Lord God,
Every man shall honor the Healer with wisdom;
The Lord created the Healer from the earth;
Know His power,
Honor Him in His lordship,
He shall deliver them through His Healer;
They shall be delivered, for they shall perform the work of the Healer among them;
My child, do not let your sickness prevail over you;
Turn away from sin; stretch forth your hand.
Give me the flour; and also give me the flour of the remembrance.
For the Lord has created him.
There is a time when it is done by their hands.
Let him help them, and let him give them rest.
He who despises the Creator shall fall into the hand of the mighty healer.

sections.title: Concerning the remembrance of a man who hath died.

verses.text: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ለሞተ ሰው አልቅስለት፥ እዘንለትም፤
እንደ ልማዱ መራራ ልቅሶ አልቅስለት፤
ከዚህ በኋላ ልቅሶህን ተው።
ኀዘንና ትካዜ ለሞት ያደርሳል፤
ኀዘንን ወደ ልቡናህ አታግባ፤
ድኅነት እንደሌለባት ዕወቅ፤ ራስህንም ትጎዳለህ፥
እኔ የተቀበልሁትን ፍዳ አስተውል፤
የሞተ ሰውስ ዐረፈ፤
የጸሓፊ ጥበቡ በተሾመበት ወራት ነው፤
ዕርፉን የሚያጸና ሰው በምንም አይራቀቅም፥
The one who plows shall be blessed;
The night shall be as the day for those who call upon Him, and He is the leader of the call-makers;
He who dwells beside the vine, and learns the craft of iron, is like unto him;
He who remains steadfast in his work is like a skilled craftsman;
With his hand, he shall shape the clay and work it;
All these shall place their hope in the work of their hands;
Without them, a nation cannot endure.
Yet, they shall not be led astray by the counsel of the wicked;
They shall not dwell in falsehood while speaking;
Knowledge, however, is for the one whose heart is enlightened.
Wisdom hath been esteemed above all the ancients.
By faith, she instructeth those who call upon her name with prophecy;
And she doth expound the parable that hath been spoken;
Among the mighty, she shall find her place;
For she discerneth both the good and the evil among men;
Yet, behold, the Lord, who is ever present, hath granted her favor;
He also shall reveal unto her wisdom and counsel;
He shall show her the wisdom of the teaching;
Concerning wisdom, many shall give her thanks;
The nations shall speak of her wisdom.
It is fitting to call upon the name of a thousand children;
I shall ponder and speak;
Hearken unto me, O ye children of the righteous; for I shall instruct you; be ye wise.
As the cedars of Lebanon, your stature shall be exalted.
Let us hear their voice;
"The work of the Lord is yet to be revealed."
"Why is this? Why is this?" Such words are not fitting;
In all His commandments, He is greatly beloved;
The work of every man is before Him;
The world, until the end of ages, He hath known all things.
All things were created for their delight.
Blessed is he who is like a flowing river of water;
Thus, His anger was kindled against the nations whom He desired to destroy.
The way of the righteous is as the dawn;
From ancient times, it was created for the good, for the righteous.
The beginning of every man's desire is his love;
All this is a blessing for the righteous.
There is a spirit that was created for the righteous;
Fire, hail, storm, and tempest, all these were created for the righteous.
The teeth of the beasts of the earth are sharp and fierce;
Yet He rejoices in His mercy.
ስለዚህ ነገር ከጥንት ጀምሮ ሁሉም ተዘጋጀ፤
የእግዚአብሔር ሥራው ሁሉ ያማረ ነውና፤
“ይህን ክፉ ፈጠርህ፤ ያንም አሳመርህ” የሚለው የለም።
አሁንም በፍጹም ልቡናችሁ፤ በፍጹምም አንደበታችሁ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት፤
The affliction of man is great;
The thought of death is a terror that strikes the hearts of all the children of Adam;
Beginning with the king who sits upon the throne of the kingdom;
Starting with the one who wears the red garment and the one who is adorned;
Anger and wrath, the sting of envy, the fear of death and strife, and also deceit;
The respite is brief or like a fleeting moment;
But the one who flees shall find his day;
All this is upon man, even unto the beasts;
Death and the grave, calamity and war, affliction and the anguish of the heart, and also destruction;
All this came upon the sinful ones;
All things were created from the earth; and all shall return to the earth.
All that is spoken and all that is done shall be remembered;
The wealth of the wicked shall vanish like flowing water;
He shall rejoice in his hand from the harvest;
The children of the wicked shall not flourish;
The reed that grows by the water and the river shall be uprooted before all its kind;
Grace, however, is like the blessing of the Lord; it is a paradise;
The one who prepares and works, his life is sweet;
Children and the name of the nation shall be called upon;
Wine and the mixture shall make our hearts rejoice;
In the season and the festival, they shall bring joy to the body.
ደም ግባትና ውበት ዐይንን ደስ ያሰኙኣታል።
ወዳጅና ጓደኛ በዘመናቸው ይጠቅማሉ፤
ወንድሞችና ረዳት በመከራ ቀን ይጠቅማሉ፤
ወርቅና ብር ሀገርን ያጸናሉ፤
ባለጸግነትና ገንዘብ ልቡናን ደስ ያሰኛሉ፤
እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በበረከትዋ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ገነት ናት፤
ልጄ ሆይ! በጉልበትህ ሳለህ ልመናን አትውደዳት፤
የሌላ ማዕድ ደጅ የሚጠናና ተስፋ የሚያደርግ ሰው፤
ለማያፍር ሰው አፍ ልመና ጣፋጭ ነው፤
ሞት ሆይ፥ ሰው በደኅና ሲኖር፥
ሞት ሆይ፥ ኀይል በሌለው፥ ፈጽሞም ባረጀ፥
የሞትን ፍርድ አትፍራ፤
እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ ለምን ትነቅፋለህ?
የኀጢአተኞች ሰዎች ልጆች ጐስቋሎች ልጆች ይሆናሉ፤
የኀጢአተኞች ልጆች ርስታቸውን ያጣሉ፤
ስለ እርሱ ይዋረዳሉና፥
የልዑል እግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ላፈረሳችሁ
ብትወልዱም ለርግማን ትወልዳላቸሁ፤
ሁሉ ከምድር ተፈጠረ፤ መመለሻውም ወደ ምድር ነው፤
The anguish of man is concerning his body;
Consider well that a good name is to be called upon;
In your time, it is good to dwell in joy;
Wisdom, however, shall keep her children in peace;
The one who brings forth wisdom is a man;
Therefore, let them seek my words and my wisdom;
Let us say that we shall bear a child and dwell in sorrow;
To change words for the foolish and the wise is folly;
To depart from a house where hospitality has been shown to a stranger is folly;
To say of one who calls you, "He is a burden," is folly;
በመከራው ጊዜ ባልንጀራህን ቸል ማለት ኀፍረት ነው፤
ገረዱንም አታባብላት፤ ወደ መኝታዋም አትቅረብ፤
ይህን ብትጠብቅ በእውነት ኀፊረ ገጽ ያለህ ትሆናለህ፤
Nevertheless, do not be dismayed concerning this matter;
Concerning the great law and concerning His covenant, do not be dismayed;
When you are in error with your friend regarding your money, do not be dismayed;
Whether it be little concerning the measure or much,
Concerning all that may benefit you and all that may assist you, do not be dismayed;
It is good to hold a key over a wicked woman;
Whatever you do, do it with number, with measure, and with balance;
A fool is a man, and a man without understanding is also a man;
A daughter is a sweet gift of sleep to her father;
That she may not be disturbed in her sacredness;
የጠላት መዘባበቻ፥ በከተማም መነጋገሪያ፥
ለሰው ሁሉ ስለ መልኩ አታድላለት፤
ከልብስ ብል ይገኛል፤
ኀፍረትንና ቅንዐትን ከምታመጣ ሴት ደግነት፤

sections.title: The glory of the Lord is in His creation.

verses.text: Therefore, I consider the work of the Lord;
The sun shines; it reveals all things;
All shall be in awe of His glory;
He knows the depths and the heart;
He speaks of that which has passed and that which is to come;
There is none who can counsel Him;
I have marveled at the wisdom of the wise;
All His works are good;
All this shall endure forever, living and abiding;
All are one, and each is a counterpart to the other; they are two by being two.
Do not forsake one another for a good cause; rather, strengthen one another.
የጠራች ጠፈርን በህዋው ላይ አጸናት፤
ብርሃኑን ያሳይ ዘንድ ፀሐይን ያወጣል፤
በዋዕዩም ሀገሩን ያቃጥላል፤
ዋዕዩንም እሳት እንደሚነድድባት ምድጃ ያደርጋል፤
የፈጠረው እግዚአብሔርም ታላቅ ነው፤
ጨረቃም ለሁሉ የዘመን መለኪያ ናት፤
በጨረቃም የበዓላት ምልክት ይታወቃል፤
ጨረቃስ እንደ ስሟ ናት፤ ዕድገትዋም ድንቅ ነው፤
የሰማይም ጌጥ የከዋክብት ብርሃን ነው።
በቅዱሱም ቃል በየሥርዐታቸው ጸንተው ይኖራሉ፤
The light is indeed exceedingly beautiful,
It shall be revealed in the heavens;
By the command, it shall be adorned with splendor;
Therefore, this matter shall be made manifest in its gathering;
In its glory, it shall cover the clouds;
In its coming, the mountains shall tremble;
The voice of the lightning shall terrify the earth;
The beauty of the lightning is wondrous to the eye;
It shall be as salt upon the earth;
The swirling wind from the east shall blow.
The mountain shall be consumed;
It is the place from whence cometh the swift destruction of all mankind;
In Him, the counsel of the wicked shall be brought to ruin;
Those who journey upon the sea shall speak of its calamity,
And there, His work is indeed marvelous.
For the good harvest shall be gathered from His bounty;
We shall speak of many things; yet we cannot accomplish them;
For He is exalted above all creation;
The Lord is to be feared;
Do not be negligent in your thanksgiving.
እርሱን አይቶ የሚነግረን ማን ነው?
የማይታየው ከዚህ የሚበልጠው ፍጥረቱ ብዙ ነው፤
እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ፈጥሯልና፤
We give thanks to the honored ones and our fathers in their generations.
For the Lord God has bestowed upon them great honor,
They have called upon His name with their might, and they have praised Him with their wisdom,
The kings of the nations in their might,
Seeking glory and a good name,
Their wealth, which they possessed, was sufficient for them,
All these were honored in their generations,
And from them, their praises shall be told,
There is none who remembers them, nor do they perish,
Yet these, indeed, their righteousness has not been forgotten.
She who is virtuous shall dwell with her children forevermore.
Their offspring shall flourish swiftly,
and their descendants shall endure forever;
their flesh shall be received in peace;
and the nations shall speak of their wisdom.
ሄኖክ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ አሰኘው፤
ኖኅም ፍጹምና ጻድቅ ሆኖ ተገኘ፤
የጥፋት ውኃ ሰውን ሁሉ እንዳያጠፋው፥
የአሕዛብ ሁሉ አባት አብርሃም ታላቅ ነው፤
እግዚአብሔርም በሰውነቱ ቃል ኪዳንን አጸናለት።
ስለዚህም አሕዛብ በዘሩ ይባረኩ ዘንድ፥
And for Isaac, concerning his father Abraham, a blessing;
And upon the head of Jacob, it was poured out;
And from among them, those who are honored shall receive grace in the sight of man;
And Moses called upon the name of the Lord, and it was blessed;
He exalted Him on high;
And by His word, He performed wonders;
Concerning their faith and concerning their holiness, they were sanctified;
And they heeded His word;
And Aaron, his brother, born of the tribe of Levi, is indeed great like him;
He has also established the law of eternity;
In all things, he is to be revered;
And around him are many robes and garments of gold;
He is adorned with a special heavenly crown, having four rows;
A white crown shall be made for him, a glorious diadem;
In the likeness of the heavenly form, a golden crown has been fashioned;
Before him, no garment was made like unto his garment;
Always, each day, the offerings of the morning and the evening shall be presented before him;
And Moses took their hands.
ለእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት ይሠዋ ዘንድ፥
ትእዛዛቱን ሰጠው፤
ሌሎች ግን ተቃወሙት፤
እግዚአብሔርም አያቸው፤ ደስም አላሰኙትም፤
ለአሮንም ክብርን ጨመረለት፤
ለእርሱና ለልጆቹም የሰጣቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን መሥዋዕት ይበሉ ዘንድ፥
የሕዝቡንም ምድር አልተካፈለም፤
የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስም በክብር ሦስተኛ ነው፤
ስለዚህም ለሕዝቡ የቅዱሳንን ሥርዐት ያስተምራቸው ዘንድ፥
ከነገደ ይሁዳ ለተወለደ ለዳዊት ልጅም ጌጥ ይሆን ዘንድ፥
በልቡናቸውም ጥበብን ያሳድርባቸው ዘንድ፥
The son of Nineveh, Jonah, is strong in the midst of the tumult. He prophesied after Moses;
His hand in the time of distress,
Who is he that was before him, like unto him?
The sun does not stand still by His word?
The enemies that are around him, in the time of their distress,
In their affliction, He has brought them low among the nations;
In the time of Moses, He granted them mercy with them;
Of six hundred thousand men, only the two of them are the ones who entered;
And the Lord gave strength unto Caleb;
Let all the children of Israel know that it is good to follow the Lord.
The mighty men of Israel, who were called by their names,
In the land where they dwelt, may their bones rejoice;
And Samuel was beloved in the sight of the Lord;
And by the law of the Lord, the congregation was established;
And by his faith, prophecy was confirmed;
When the wolf of the flock roared, the enemies were troubled in their distress;
And the Lord looked down from heaven;
And He destroyed all the kings of the Philistines and of Tyre.
The day of his death shall not come upon him, for the Lord and for his mercy;
After his death, prophecy was spoken.
And after Him, we arose;
As the poor are distinguished by their offerings;
In Him, the lion is as a fierce young lion;
Is it not true that in his youth, he did not slay the warrior?
For we dwell in the presence of the Most High God;
And the singers said unto David, "Ten thousand are your warriors;"
And they surrounded his enemies and struck them down;
In all the work that he performed, let us give thanks to the Holy and Most High God with words of praise;
And before the sanctuary, let us establish the singers;
He also made a good feast.
And the Lord has removed my transgression from me;
And after him, a wise son was born.
Solomon also reigned in a time of peace.
O Solomon, how did thy wisdom arise from thy childhood?
Thy wisdom hath spread over the earth.
And thy name was heard even unto distant shores.
The nations spoke of thy psalms, of thy proverbs.
Concerning the God of Israel, who is called by the name of the Lord.
Women were drawn to thy heart.
Thy glory was exalted; and thy lineage was established.
Thy kingdom was established.
Yet the Lord has not forsaken His mercy;
And Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord, as did his fathers.
And their sins were fully upon them.
And their transgressions sought to overtake them, for they desired all manner of sin.
And the prophet Elijah arose as fire,
And he brought forth a drought upon them;
By the word of the Lord, he shut up the heavens;
O Elijah, how great are thy wonders!
Who is he that can raise the dead from the grave, apart from the Almighty Word?
To the kings he brought death,
In the sight of the Lord's wrath,
They shall perish, the kings,
In the fire of the furnace and by the fire of the horse,
Before their fall, he shall turn back the wrath of the Lord.
Those who know You and are gathered in Your love are holy.
Elijah is he who ascended in a chariot of fire;
Among all that he spoke, none was found to be false;
While he lived, he performed wondrous miracles;
Yet, despite all this, the people did not heed his words;
And among them, there were those who did indeed perform works.
ሕዝቅያስም ከተማውን አጸና
ሰናክሬምም በዘመኑ ዘመተ፤
ያን ጊዜም ልቡናቸው ደነገጠባቸው፤
ይቅር ባይ እግዚአብሔርንም ለመኑት፤
የአሦርንም ሠራዊት አጠፋ፤
ሕዝቅያስ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኘው ሥራ ሠርትዋልና፤
ፀሐይም በዘመኑ ከመሄድ ወደ ኋላ ተመለሰች፤
በታላቅ መንፈስም በመጨረሻ የሚሆነውን አየ፤
ለዘለዓለሙ የሚሆነውን፥
The remembrance of Josiah is as a fragrant offering, established in the presence of the Lord;
He is the one who is righteous;
And he directed his heart unto God;
Except for David, Hezekiah, and Josiah, all have turned aside;
For they have given their strength unto another.
The city which is chosen and consecrated, I shall destroy it.
They have been afflicted; yet He shall be a prophet.
Ezekiel also beheld the vision of His majesty,
And he gathered together his adversaries in the appointed time,
The twelve prophets also lamented in their respective places,
How shall we deliver Zerubbabel!
The son of Jehoiada, Josiah, was likewise present;
The remembrance of Nehemiah is abundant;
There is none like a man who was created upon the earth as Enoch;
And there has not been born a man like Joseph;
A male and a female are more esteemed than a man.
The great priest Simon, son of Onias,
Likewise, he established the foundation of the altar and made it strong.
In his time, the springs of water did not fail;
The people were guarded lest they should fall.
When he came forth from the house of the sanctuary, he was honored among the people.
In the cloud, he was like a shining star,
And upon the lofty sanctuary, he was as the sun that shines.
As a fruitful tree in the season of harvest, he was.
Upon the altar, there was a white flame like a fire.
Its fruit was abundant, like the olive tree.
And He wore the robe of glory;
When the priests received the portion of the sacrifice from the hand of the priest;
Likewise, all the sons of Aaron donned their garments of glory;
And in the sanctuary, they were to perform their duties;
Holding the wine in his hand, he lifted it up;
And the sons of Aaron, while calling out, were to proclaim the blessing;
At that time, all the people were to unite in harmony;
And the singers were to give thanks with their words;
And the people were to pray to the Most High God;
After this, He would come down to bestow the blessing of the Lord upon them.
Let them receive the blessing of the Most High, for they have called upon Him in earnest.
Even now, in every place, many miracles are wrought.
He shall grant us the joy of our hearts;
For in His goodness, He is steadfast with us;
My body has been pursued by two adversaries;
These dwell in Samaria and in the mountains of Philistia;
The man of Jerusalem, the son of Sirach, who awakens wisdom from his heart;
He who does this is indeed a righteous one, and he shall be blessed therein;
And he who does this can do all things.

sections.title: The Prayer of Jesus, Son of Sirach.

verses.text: O Lord, my King! I beseech Thee;
For Thou hast delivered me, and Thou hast saved me;
According to the multitude of Thy mercy, and for Thy name's sake, have Thou delivered me;
Like a garment that is worn out;
From beneath, from the grave's belly;
And unto the King, in the time of trial, my body hath come unto death;
Around me they have surrounded; and there is none to help me;
O Lord, I remember Thy mercy;
And my supplication I have lifted up from the earth unto the heights;
My Father and my Lord, even God Almighty;
I give thanks to Thy name forever;
Thou hast delivered me from death; on the day of trouble, Thou hast rescued me.
When I was a child, I did not forget to seek wisdom;
In the house of the sanctuary, I longed for her.
Her fruit is as the fruit of the tree;
With mine ears, I have heard her; I have chosen her;
And I have exalted her greatly;
I have considered her in my heart;
My body hath been strengthened by her;
And I have directed my body towards her; in purity, I have found her.
ሰውነቴም ለእርስዋ ታወከች፤ መረመረቻትም፤
እግዚአብሔርም አንደበትን ዋጋ አድርጎ ሰጠኝ፤
እናንት አላዋቂዎች፥ ወደ እኔ ቅረቡ፤
እንዴት አጣችኋት? እስኪ ንገሩኝ!
አፌን ከፍቼ፥ “ያለ ዋጋ ገንዘብ አድርጓት” ብዬ ተናገርሁ።
አንገታችሁን ዝቅ አድርጉ፤ ቀንበሯንም ተሸከሙ፤
እነሆ፥ ጥቂት ደክሜ በእርሷ ብዙ ዕረፍትን እንዳገኘሁ፥
ከብዙ ብር ይልቅ ጥበብን ምረጧት፤
ሰውነታችሁም በቸርነቱ ደስ ይበላት፤
በጊዜው ዋጋችሁን ይሰጣችሁ ዘንድ፥
